title_short: Berlin Batch 2 · Script 12 · Walk, or Segway?
length: about 40 s (keep the current cut's length)
headline: Two friends race across Berlin, one on foot and one on a Segway F3. Mavis asked for three fixes and to keep the rest as it is: one face blurred, the one-handed riding shot out, and only the bottom shot of the split at 0:16.
story: Script 12 of the Berlin Batch 2 TikToks for Segway Germany. The bet: is Berlin faster on foot or on a Segway? The script was written for three people and a car; SOM shot two people and no car, so the cut is walker against rider. German is the master audio and the captions are German.

Where it stands: Mavis on 27 Oct: I suggest blurring the face of the person in the middle - other than that, you can just keep it as is. On V2 (3 Nov) she asked to remove the shot of the scooter ridden with one hand (0:12) and, at 0:16, to delete the shot above and keep only the one below. Those three fixes are the whole job. Nothing else changes.
do: Open cold on 12.1 at 01:20 with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Apply Mavis's three fixes: blur the face in the middle, remove the one-handed shot (0:12 of V2), keep only the bottom shot of the split at 0:16.
Keep everything else as in the current cut.
German captions, burned in, checked word by word against the audio.
If the model is named on screen or in the voice, it is the F3 D (the German model).
dont: No speed number, speedometer or speed claim anywhere (20 km/h limit in Germany).
No riding with one hand on screen.
No driver, no third panel, no parking joke: only two people were shot.
No novelty or comedy music or stings.
No logo before the end card. No drone shots.
